title: CORS in 60 seconds

scenes.code:
Access to fetch at "https://api.other.com"
from origin "https://myapp.com"
has been blocked by CORS policy
scenes.say: You've seen this error. Your code is probably fine. The browser is protecting you.

scenes.heading: Same-origin policy
scenes.say: By default, a page can't read responses from another origin. Otherwise any site you visit could read your bank or your email, using your logged-in cookies.
CORS is how a server opts in. It sends headers saying which origins are allowed to read its responses.

items.title: Preflight
items.say: Some requests send a preflight first: an OPTIONS request asking permission.

items.title: Fix it on the server
items.say: And the fix lives on the server, not in your frontend code.

scenes.say: That's CORS. The browser asks. The server decides.

caption: CORS in 60 seconds: why the browser blocks your fetch, and why the fix lives on the server.
